_comment: Analyst-pair reference-value ledger for Chutes TEE (Intel TDX) inference. Each entry is an mrtd (TD measurement) the (user, agent) pair has observed live and cross-checked against the provider's self-published golden set at /servers/tee/measurements. IMPORTANT — this is a WEAKER audit unit than near-ai's cloud-api ledger: mrtd measures only the dstack base TD, NOT serve.py on the prompt-plaintext path (CFSV-excluded, in no RTMR — see verifiers/chutes.py), and the model sits in no measured register (MRTD/RTMRs are identical across all -TEE models). So a matching mrtd attests the base image only; it does NOT prove the serving code wasn't modified to read/exfiltrate the decrypted prompt or substitute the model. Reference value = mrtd; source-of-truth for serving code = chutes-api (unmeasured). Anchor = provider golden set (self-attested, not on-chain). Refresh: when a new mrtd is observed in the golden set, append a row; mrtd is instance-sampled, so the fleet flip-flops between coexisting values rather than deploying serially.

audits.notes: Live-observed mrtd, present in the provider golden set at every sampling 2026-06-25 through 2026-09-02; currently-serving fleet value. TDX quote self-consistent (dcap_qvl), report_data binds the E2E pubkey and the attestation-svc cert SPKI, debug disabled. Attests the dstack base TD only. serve.py (prompt-plaintext path) is CFSV-excluded and in no measured register, so this mrtd does NOT cover the serving code or model identity; not comparable to near-ai backend_attested. Base-image-to-source mapping not reproduced from a chutes-api build.

The second coexisting fleet mrtd, retired from sampling after 2026-08-06. Same posture and same serving-code caveat as the current value; the two values flip-flopped across daily samples (instance-sampled identity) rather than representing serial deploys.
